scenarios.name: Essence Flux blinks a creature that is not a Spirit and its counters cease to exist
scenarios.ruling: The creature returns to the battlefield as a new object, so any counters on the exiled permanent cease to exist, and a non-Spirit gets no new counter.

scenarios.name: A Spirit returns from exile with a +1/+1 counter on it
scenarios.ruling: Essence Flux checks whether the creature is a Spirit after it has returned, so a 3/3 Spirit comes back as a 4/4 with one +1/+1 counter.

scenarios.name: Blinking a creature makes its enters-the-battlefield ability trigger again
scenarios.ruling: The permanent really leaves the battlefield and enters again as a new object, so Wall of Omens' enters trigger sees it enter and draws a card.

scenarios.name: The blinked creature comes back to the battlefield rather than staying in exile
scenarios.ruling: The exile is only momentary: the same card returns to the battlefield under its owner's control as part of the same resolution, so nothing is left in exile.
